rca_of_the_issue.bug: ReactQuill WYSIWYG editor crashes when opening post modal
rca_of_the_issue.error_message: TypeError: react_dom_1.default.findDOMNode is not a function
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: react-quill v2.0.0 internally uses ReactDOM.findDOMNode() which was deprecated in React 17 and completely removed in React 19. The app uses React 19.0.0.
reproduction_steps: 4. Modal attempts to render ReactQuill editor
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Replace react-quill with a React 19 compatible rich text editor such as @tiptap/react, lexical, or slate. Alternatively, downgrade React to v18 if react-quill is required.
